name: Akiiro Renka
source:
Recently having both of his parents leaving the house in order to take jobs abroad; our hero leads a solitary, invalid existence. Even his stepsister cannot lend him a hand because she's not living with him either. Thankfully, a neighbor (and fellow classmate) takes it upon herself to help the kid out. Furthermore, a World-Class tennis player (whom our hero idolizes) is injured while touring the globe. She now attends the same class as he, until she gets better. With all these cute women surrounding him--and he having a place for himself--how will he take action?

[Edited from White Masq]
translation:
主人公的父母最近双双出国工作，他过着孤独而颓废的生活。就连义妹也帮不上忙，因为她并不和他住在一起。好在一位邻居（同时也是同班同学）主动承担起了照顾他的责任。此外，一位世界级网球选手（也是主人公的偶像）在巡回赛中受伤，目前和他同班就读，直到伤愈为止。身边环绕着这么多可爱的女孩，而他又独享一处住所——他会采取怎样的行动呢？

[改编自White Masq]
